description: Browse the merchandise catalog (Kingdom Hearts, Demon Slayer and One Piece) by series, character, budget and purpose. Use it to answer "what merch exists for X?" or "gift ideas under ¥5,000". Example: {ip: "kingdom-hearts", character: "Sora", budget_jpy: 5000, purpose: "display"}. Omit ip to search every series. Returns items[] (sku_id, name_en/name_ja, official, original price msrp_jpy plus price_local/currency, price_basis, price_note_en for per-draw prices, region, availability_hint, typical_channels, source_url, page_url = the item's page on merchgraph.app) and total_matches. For a series that is not covered, items is empty and supported_series lists the covered ones. If a character has no solo merch (e.g. Xigbar), the result also has suggested_character_group and suggested_items for their group (e.g. Organization XIII). Lists catalog entries only; it does not mean anything is for sale right now. Use explain_product with a sku_id for full details.

budget_jpy.description: Maximum original price in Japanese yen (overseas items are compared at a fixed rate), e.g. 5000. Optional.

character.description: Character name in English or Japanese, e.g. "Sora", "ソラ", "Organization XIII". Partial match. Optional.

ip.description: Series ID. Live series: "kingdom-hearts" (Kingdom Hearts), "kimetsu-no-yaiba" (Demon Slayer), "one-piece" (One Piece). Optional: omit to search all of them.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 10). total_matches always gives the full count.

purpose.description: "display" = figures, plush, prizes, acrylic stands; "wear" = apparel; "read" = books; "play" = games and cards; "any" (default).

terms.description: Filter by series vocabulary (factions, worlds, keyblades, songs…) found in item names, aliases or notes. Optional.

names.description: Only items mentioning these series terms, in English or Japanese, e.g. ["Heartless"], ["XIII機関"], ["Kingdom Key"].

types.description: Only items mentioning a series term of these kinds (character/faction/world/item/keyblade/song/event/other).

name: discover
title: Browse the catalog
